buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses The bidder should quote for the product having equivalent or better specification.

Technical Specification and Warranty Declaration should be given in OEM letterhead with authorized signatory. The average annual Turnover of the OEMs of NAS Storage and Firewall for last 3 year s must be more than 1000 Crores each. The OEMs of the NAS Storage and Firewall each must have existence and business tr ansactions in India for last 10 years (documentary evidence required). The bidder should be the authorized seller of the OEM and must provide bid specific OEM authorization certificate in OEM's letter head with authorized signatory. The bid value of the product should not exceed its sanctioned budget of Rs. 2,75,00, 000/-. The bidder should provide call escalation matrix and toll free numbers to resolve issu es. The Bidder must provide a checklist of compliance of specification duly signed and st amped in OEMs letter head which is given in ATC as Annexure 1. For the purpose of better project manageability and compatibility, only those bidders or Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) who have submitted valid bids under G EM Bid No. GEM/2026/B/8229783 dated 02.11.2026 and GEM Bid No. GEM/2026/B/8228939 dated 02.11.2026 shall be eligible to participate in this curre nt tender. Participation shall be limited to such bidders/OEMs, subject to compliance with all terms and conditions specified herein. No other bidder shall be considered for evaluation under this tender. Any misrepresentation or fraudulent concealment regarding the credentials of the bi dder or the quality and specification of the product would entail legal consequences. . 3.
